The durable composite boxes are treated as operational assets rather than single-use trash, remaining in active restaurant-to-consumer circulation loops for over five years without degrading in material quality

The execution successfully prevented the procurement, handling, and disposal of over 5 million single-use takeaway boxes

The captured methane gas undergoes micro-processing inside the AD plant to be converted into high-grade biodiesel. This fuel is immediately routed back to power the very trucks that complete the weekly commercial waste collections
